From: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@finobank.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant deletion timestamp verification & audit logs request

Diego,

Hope you're well. As part of Finobank's quarterly compliance sweep and our SOC 2 readiness checks, our internal audit team needs verification that the 'finobank-prod' tenant deletion you performed in May was executed and that deletion artifacts are traceable back to object timestamps and retention/TTL enforcement runs.

Specifically, please provide the following evidence:  
- A machine-readable list of deletion events for tenant 'finobank-prod' with precise timestamps (UTC) and the service component that emitted the event.
- Object-level manifests or hashlists (object keys, sizes, and SHA256 digests) showing tombstone/deletion markers and final garbage-collection confirmations.
- The retention/TTL job run id(s) that correspond to the removal window and any failure/retry logs.
- Any KMS/HSM key rotation metadata associated with the objects (redacted where necessary).
- A short statement attesting to retention policy enforcement for this tenant and the point-in-time when data moved from 'in-use' to 'deleted' state.

We're looking to include this packet in a consolidated auditor handoff by next Friday, 2026-07-02. If you can flag anything that will need additional legal/attestation steps, let me know.

Thanks,
Sarah Ellis
Senior Compliance Manager, Finobank
(sarah.ellis@finobank.com)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@finobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant deletion timestamp verification & audit logs request

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary of provenance for you so auditors can triage: 

- Source of truth for deletion events: audit-collector (write-audit) which forwards canonical deletion events to our clickhouse archive (deletion_events) and S3-backed manifests (manifests/tenant/<tenant>/). Each event includes a microsecond UTC timestamp, source component (ingest-service / retention-service / manual-erase), and a UUID correlation id.
- Object-level tombstones: after TTL enforcement objects are marked with a tombstone and are eligible for GC. We retain the final manifest that records the last known object key and SHA256.
- Retention/TTL job metadata: runs are recorded with run-id (format ttl-run-####) in retention-ops logs; we correlate run-id to deletion events via correlation id.

I'll ask Soojin to pull an anonymized CSV of the deletion events and a manifest export. Marissa will coordinate packaging and delivery, and we can produce a short attestation draft for signature.

Attachments: request-instructions.pdf (we use this internally to format evidence for auditors).

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Sarah / team — I pulled the initial artifacts and small samples below. I'm attaching a sanitized CSV (deletion-trace-samples.csv) and the deletion manifest for the tenant.

Key details and reproducible queries:
- ClickHouse query (internal):
  SELECT tenant_id, object_key, sha256, event_type, timestamp_utc, component, correlation_id
  FROM deletion_events
  WHERE tenant_id = 'finobank-prod'
  AND timestamp_utc BETWEEN '2026-05-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-05-07T23:59:59Z'
  ORDER BY timestamp_utc ASC

- Example sample rows (sanitized):
  finobank-prod, s3://redwood/objects/abc123, e3b0c44298fc1c14..., tombstone_written, 2026-05-03T14:22:17.123456Z, retention-service, corr-9876
  finobank-prod, s3://redwood/objects/def456, e3b0c44298fc1c14..., gc_confirmed, 2026-05-03T14:45:02.987654Z, garbage-collector, corr-9876

- Retention run metadata: TTL run id ttl-run-1427 corresponds to the enforcement window 2026-05-03T14:20:00Z — 2026-05-03T14:50:00Z. The retention-ops log contains per-object status and retry counts. I'm attaching retention-ttl-run-1427.log (redacted for tenant ids outside finobank) and the manifest finobank-prod-deletion-manifest.jsonl.

A few notes on KMS/HSM metadata: we can provide key ids and rotation timestamps but not private key material. If the auditors need key rotation attestations, we can include KMS audit entries as a separate artifact.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Staff SRE, Platform Infra
Redwood Inference
